facts.text: WSU's Cougar Commitment covers tuition and mandatory fees for Washington residents from low- or middle-income families who receive the Washington College Grant or a Pell Grant.
Washington State uses the University Writing Portfolio, a mid-career check of whether each student's writing is ready for advanced-level courses.
